quote.summary: Ingenic Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a China-based company principally engaged in the sales of integrated circuits (ICs) and provision of technical services. The Company's main products include memory IC, computing IC and analog IC. The memory IC products include dynamic random access memory (DRAM), static random access memory (SRAM), NOR Flash, and NAND Flash. Computing IC mainly cover three categories: intelligent vision system-on-chip (SoC), embedded microprocessor unit (MPU), and artificial intelligence microcontroller unit (AI-MCU). The analog IC portfolio includes linear drivers, DC-DC drivers, matrix drivers, power management ICs, ambient lighting drivers, and RGB drivers. The Company's products mainly used in automotive electronics, industrial and medical applications, as well as the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) and intelligent security devices. The Company mainly operates its business in the domestic and overseas markets.
